svg.title: Identical C: every compiler/profile
svg.desc: Each cell is a percentage of SDCC 4.5 Size bytes or Speed T-states for the same workload. Lower is better. E means compilation error. A dash means no variant. Source SHA256: d966f4cc1026a037b490e451c9333ceb8f1fad3fe211c6ad5f4ec0e6c631ba30.
svg.text: Lower is better. Green: below reference; red: above; 100%: equal.
E = compilation error; — = no variant. Bare Z80, fixed inputs; no ULA contention.
